items.title: Checkmarx KICS Official Docker Repo Compromised to Inject Malicious Code
items.description: A significant supply chain attack targeting the official checkmarx/kics Docker Hub repository, where threat actors pushed trojanized images capable of harvesting and exfiltrating sensitive developer credentials and infrastructure secrets. Docker’s internal monitoring flagged suspicious activity around KICS image tags on April 22, 2026, and promptly alerted Socket researchers. The investigation…
